waste.methodologyNote: CO₂ values use the Agribalyse LCA database via Open Food Facts ecoscore_data and assume the average pack weight of the product's category. EUR values use per-product overrides when set, otherwise category averages. Records written before the count model are not included: their figures were scaled by the net content of the product. Hard-deleted products fall into the "Other" bucket. The reason for a waste is optional: a waste without one counts as waste and stays unattributed.
